summary: Learn to assess property sustainability data, use GRESB and CRREM references, and prioritize asset actions. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Real estate sustainability assessment helps property professionals compare building performance and identify improvement priorities. For asset managers, sustainability professionals, and property operations leads, the course covers organizing energy and emissions data, using GRESB and CRREM reference points, and screening retrofit options by cost, carbon, and disruption. Participants also review building assessment evidence and prepare asset action plans with reporting indicators.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess building performance, set property improvement priorities, or prepare sustainability evidence for real estate assets and portfolios.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with real estate assets, property operations, sustainability reporting, or investment analysis. No coding is required; exercises use building data examples and spreadsheet calculations.
